description: Fictional English community committee call with revised repair counts, budget arithmetic, a corrected room booking and an unresolved lighting expense.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Before we book the hall, let's settle the chair repairs and cleaning costs. We must also check the time against the children's class.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I have a quote. Repairing fourteen chairs costs two hundred and eighty dollars, including delivery, but I haven't checked the quantity.

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: There are twelve damaged chairs, not fourteen. I counted them myself. Four other chairs are usable, so we'll have sixteen seats after repairs.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Please ask for a revised repair quote. Replacing all twelve chairs was suggested, but I don't want to approve that without comparing costs.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Replacement would be thirty five dollars per chair, or four hundred and twenty dollars altogether. The repair company has already confirmed twenty dollars for each chair.

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: That makes the repairs two hundred and forty dollars. The cleaner's quote is another one hundred and eighty, so those two jobs would total four hundred and twenty.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Our budget is six hundred dollars. Let's repair the twelve chairs and book the cleaner, leaving one hundred and eighty in reserve. We aren't ordering replacement chairs.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I'll confirm the quantity and arrange collection by Thursday at noon. The chairs should return on Friday, but I'll request written confirmation.

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: I can contact the cleaner today. The booking draft says Saturday from nine until noon. Is that still the session we're preparing for?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Correction. The children's class has Saturday morning. Our session is Sunday from ten until one, and the Saturday request needs to be cancelled.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Sunday from ten until one. That gives us the whole session without sharing the room. I'll put the corrected time on the equipment delivery note.

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: The cleaner has confirmed Sunday at eight thirty, finishing by nine thirty. That leaves half an hour before our session starts.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I'll update the calendar and send the corrected invitation by Wednesday at five. I don't want both versions circulating.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: What about the lamp above the entrance? The switch worked yesterday, but the light kept flickering. Should we use some of the remaining money for that?

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: We don't have a quote yet. I can ask for an inspection, but requesting a price isn't the same as authorizing work. No repair should start automatically.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Keep the reserve untouched until we see the inspection result and price. If it's urgent, we'll discuss it again before approving work.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I'll separate the chair paperwork from the lighting request, so we don't charge an inspection fee to the confirmed chair order.

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: I'll circulate the lighting quote when it arrives. I can't promise a repair date today, and we haven't decided whether an inspection fee would be acceptable.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: The confirmed items are twelve repaired chairs, Sunday morning cleaning, and the room reservation for Sunday from ten until one.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: My task is the chair collection and delivery confirmation by Thursday at noon. I'll check that the final chair invoice says two hundred and forty dollars.

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: I'll handle the cleaner and request the lighting quote. Approved jobs total four hundred and twenty dollars. Lighting work and inspection fees remain undecided.
